required_semantics: Mark a realized class and existing subclasses under the runtime lock; future subclasses inherit the mark.
On the last release send _objc_initiateDealloc instead of dealloc while retaining the deallocating state.
The custom method eventually calls dealloc; retain/release must not resurrect or deallocate the object twice.
Weak loads return nil and deallocating instances must not enter autorelease pools.
required_native_checks: Normal unmarked objects preserve existing deallocation.
Delayed custom deallocation works across threads.
Existing and future subclasses inherit the behavior.
Repeated retain/release and autorelease during deferred destruction do not resurrect or double free.
Weak reference behavior and final destruction remain correct.
